_comment: Policy-driven seed allowlist (seeding mechanism ONLY — this PR does NOT modify skills/ and does NOT de-brand). A NEW profile seeds only the ids in 'seed' (27 of the 76 bundled skills); everything not listed — including future upstream skills — is NOT seeded (fail-closed). The seed SET is decoupled from skills/: this policy is the only thing that decides composition, so the upstream skill tree is never trimmed for curation, and skills/ is kept verbatim upstream (no renames, no content edits). De-branding the seeded skills whose upstream names carry a vendor brand (e.g. claude-design, baoyu-infographic) is intentionally OUT OF SCOPE here and handled in a SEPARATE follow-up PR; until then they are seeded under their upstream names. Ids are matched against each bundled skill's SKILL.md frontmatter `name`; a stale id (renamed/removed upstream) fails the CI guard (tools/check_seed_policy.py).
status: FROZEN 2026-06-10 — 27-skill seed set = the Feishu table's preset (预置保留 24 + 去品牌后保留 3). Pure allowlist over the PRISTINE upstream skills/ (no in-place renames/content edits); the 3 brand-named skills are seeded under their upstream names here and de-branded in a separate follow-up PR.

source.note: 27 seed = 预置保留 24 + 去品牌后保留 3 (claude-design / baoyu-infographic / nano-pdf)。本 PR 只做 seeding 机制、skills/ 原封不动,这 3 个按上游原名预置;去品牌(改名/内容)走单独的 follow-up PR。
